verses.original: Παῦλος καὶ Σιλουανὸς καὶ Τιμόθεος Τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ Θεσσαλονικέων ἐν Θεῷ Πατρὶ καὶ Κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ Χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη
verses.transliteration: Paulos kai Silouanos kai Timotheos Tē ekklēsia Thessalonikeōn en Theō Patri kai Kyriō Iēsou Christō Charis hymin kai eirēnē
verses.literal: Paul Silvanus and Timothy To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ Grace and peace to you
verses.literalPt: Paulo, Silvano e Timóteo, à igreja dos tessalonicenses em Deus Pai e no Senhor Jesus Cristo: graça e paz vos sejam dadas.

verses.original: Εὐχαριστοῦμεν τῷ Θεῷ πάντοτε περὶ πάντων ὑμῶν μνείαν ποιούμενοι ἐπὶ τῶν προσευχῶν ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: Eucharistoumen tō Theō pantote peri pantōn hymōn mneian poioumenoi epi tōn proseuchōn hēmōn
verses.literal: We always thank . . . . . . God for all of you remembering you . . . in our prayers
verses.literalPt: Sempre damos graças a Deus por todos vós, fazendo menção de vós em nossas orações,

verses.original: ἀδιαλείπτως μνημονεύοντες ὑμῶν τοῦ ἔργου τῆς πίστεως καὶ τοῦ κόπου τῆς ἀγάπης καὶ τῆς ὑπομονῆς τῆς ἐλπίδος τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ Πατρὸς ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: adialeiptōs mnēmoneuontes hymōn tou ergou tēs pisteōs kai tou kopou tēs agapēs kai tēs hypomonēs tēs elpidos tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou emprosthen tou Theou kai Patros hēmōn
verses.literal: and continually recalling before our God and Father your work of faith your labor of love and your enduring hope in our Lord Jesus Christ
verses.literalPt: lembrando-nos, sem cessar, diante do nosso Deus e Pai, da vossa obra da fé, do trabalho do amor e da firmeza da esperança em nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo,

verses.original: εἰδότες ἀδελφοὶ ἠγαπημένοι ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ τὴν ἐκλογὴν ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: eidotes adelphoi ēgapēmenoi hypo tou Theou tēn eklogēn hymōn
verses.literal: Brothers who are beloved by God we know that He has chosen you
verses.literalPt: conhecendo, irmãos amados de Deus, a vossa eleição,

verses.original: ὅτι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον ἡμῶν οὐκ ἐγενήθη εἰς ὑμᾶς ἐν λόγῳ μόνον ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐν δυνάμει καὶ ἐν Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ καὶ ἐν πληροφορίᾳ πολλῇ καθὼς οἴδατε οἷοι ἐγενήθημεν ἐν ὑμῖν δι’ ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: hoti to euangelion hēmōn ouk egenēthē eis hymas en logō monon alla kai en dynamei kai en Pneumati Hagiō kai en plērophoria pollē kathōs oidate hoioi egenēthēmen en hymin di’ hymas
verses.literal: because our gospel came to you not only in word but also in power in the Holy Spirit and with great conviction just as you know we lived among you for your sake . . .
verses.literalPt: porque nosso evangelho não veio a vós somente com palavras, mas também com poder, com o Espírito Santo e com muita convicção, como sabeis quais nos tornamos entre vós por amor de vós.

verses.original: Καὶ ὑμεῖς μιμηταὶ ἡμῶν ἐγενήθητε καὶ τοῦ Κυρίου δεξάμενοι τὸν λόγον ἐν θλίψει πολλῇ μετὰ χαρᾶς Πνεύματος Ἁγίου
verses.transliteration: Kai hymeis mimētai hēmōn egenēthēte kai tou Kyriou dexamenoi ton logon en thlipsei pollē meta charas Pneumatos Hagiou
verses.literal: And you became imitators of us and of the Lord when you welcomed the message with the joy of the Holy Spirit in spite of your great suffering
verses.literalPt: Vós vos fizestes imitadores nossos e do Senhor, tendo recebido a palavra no meio de muita tribulação, com gozo do Espírito Santo,

verses.original: ὥστε γενέσθαι ὑμᾶς τύπον πᾶσιν τοῖς πιστεύουσιν ἐν τῇ Μακεδονίᾳ καὶ ἐν τῇ Ἀχαΐᾳ
verses.transliteration: hōste genesthai hymas typon pasin tois pisteuousin en tē Makedonia kai en tē Achaia
verses.literal: As a result you have become an example to all the believers in Macedonia and - Achaia
verses.literalPt: de sorte que vos tornastes modelo para todos os crentes na Macedônia e na Acaia.

verses.original: ἀφ’ ὑμῶν γὰρ ἐξήχηται ὁ λόγος τοῦ Κυρίου οὐ μόνον ἐν τῇ Μακεδονίᾳ καὶ ἐν τῇ Ἀχαΐᾳ ἀλλ’ ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν ἡ πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν ἐξελήλυθεν ὥστε μὴ χρείαν ἔχειν ἡμᾶς λαλεῖν τι
verses.transliteration: aph’ hymōn gar exēchētai ho logos tou Kyriou ou monon en tē Makedonia kai en tē Achaia all’ en panti topō hē pistis hymōn hē pros ton Theon exelēlythen hōste mē chreian echein hēmas lalein ti
verses.literal: For not only did the message of the Lord ring out from you to Macedonia and - Achaia but your faith in God has gone out to every place so that we have no need to say anything more
verses.literalPt: Pois de vós fez-se ouvir a palavra do Senhor não somente na Macedônia e na Acaia, mas também em todos os lugares divulgou-se a vossa fé para com Deus, de maneira que não nos é necessário dizer coisa alguma;

verses.original: αὐτοὶ γὰρ περὶ ἡμῶν ἀπαγγέλλουσιν ὁποίαν εἴσοδον ἔσχομεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ πῶς ἐπεστρέψατε πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν ἀπὸ τῶν εἰδώλων δουλεύειν Θεῷ ζῶντι καὶ ἀληθινῷ
verses.transliteration: autoi gar peri hēmōn apangellousin hopoian eisodon eschomen pros hymas kai pōs epestrepsate pros ton Theon apo tōn eidōlōn douleuein Theō zōnti kai alēthinō
verses.literal: For they themselves report - what kind of welcome you gave us . . . . . . and how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God
verses.literalPt: porque eles mesmos anunciam de nós qual a entrada que tivemos entre vós e como vos convertestes dos ídolos a Deus, para servirdes ao Deus vivo e verdadeiro

verses.original: καὶ ἀναμένειν τὸν Υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἐκ τῶν οὐρανῶν ὃν ἤγειρεν ἐκ τῶν νεκρῶν Ἰησοῦν τὸν ῥυόμενον ἡμᾶς ἐκ τῆς ὀργῆς τῆς ἐρχομένης
verses.transliteration: kai anamenein ton Huion autou ek tōn ouranōn hon ēgeiren ek tōn nekrōn Iēsoun ton rhyomenon hēmas ek tēs orgēs tēs erchomenēs
verses.literal: and to await His Son from heaven whom He raised from the dead Jesus our deliverer from the coming wrath
verses.literalPt: e para aguardardes dos céus seu Filho, a quem ele ressuscitou dentre os mortos — a saber, Jesus, que nos livra da ira vindoura.
